title: Convolutional Neural Network
description: Turn your matrice data into predictions using convolutions.
content:
**Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)** is a type of neural network designed to handle structured grid data, such as images.

> It consists of multiple layer types:
> • Convolutional layers - apply kernels (filters) to the input to capture local structures, e.g. borders or textures.
> • Pooling layers - downsample feature maps, reducing computational complexity and extracting the most important features.
> • Fully connected layers - combine the extracted features and generate the outputs.

Typically CNNs are applied in computer vision tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification. However, CNNs could be generalized into matrix data domain which might cover, for example, natural language processing: sentences or documents are usually represented as matrices, where each row corresponds to a token, typically represented as a dense vector (embedding); then filters capture local patterns (like n-grams) by sliding them over the input matrix.
